summary: Iteration 25 — Scope (Görünüş Miqyası) & /api/sales-members bug fix. Backend: 12/12 pytest PASS — role POST/PUT persists 'scopes' field, /api/sales-members now returns 200 with array (previous missing-return bug fixed), apply_scope() correctly filters /api/tasks, /api/meetings, /api/members, /api/sales-leads, /api/project-events, /api/assemblies when role scope='own' (non-owned records hidden), admin is never scoped, default scope is 'all', assert_scope_ownership returns 403 on non-owned PUT and 200 on own PUT, sales manager can POST /api/tasks. Frontend: Settings → Rollar → edit modal shows 'Görünüş Miqyası' table with all 7 modules (members, companies, sales, tasks, meetings, assembly, projects) with data-testids scope-{module}-{all|own}; toggling and saving a scope persists on backend (verified by reopening modal and inspecting radio state). Tasks modal task-assignee-select and Meetings modal meeting-employee-select both show merged 29-option dropdown (system users + HR employees), confirming users+employeeNames merge.

issues: React warning: Missing `Description` or `aria-describedby={undefined}` for DialogContent — cosmetic a11y warning only, not blocking

critical_code_review_comments: server.py:1528-1533 /api/sales-leads/stats re-calls apply_scope() inside a loop over LEAD_STATUSES; this issues one extra DB round-trip per status for the scope lookup (get_user_scopes). Minor perf improvement: cache scopes once per request or pass pre-computed scoped base filter. Not blocking.

server.py SCOPE_FIELDS uses user.get('name','') for identification. If two users share the same 'name' string, their records will cross-leak under scope=own. Consider matching by user id or user email with a dedicated 'created_by_id' field for strong isolation. Currently UUID name collision unlikely but worth hardening.
server.py:346 assert_scope_ownership returns early for admin but also if record is None; for PUT endpoints the caller already 404s on missing record, so this branch is safe. Good.
server.py:1631 /api/sales-members now correctly returns the list. Good fix.
Frontend Settings.jsx role modal and Tasks/Meetings merging list de-duplicates by plain `new Set()` on names — same collision risk as backend scope. Minor.
